title: Bishkek State University signed a memorandum of cooperation with Assumption University (Bangkok, Thailand)

blocks.text: From April 28 to May 3 of this year, Bishkek State University (BSU), represented by the representative of the faculty of pedagogical education, M.A. Muratalieva, took part in the work of the international educational forum “Thailand–Central Asia International Education Consortium Cooperation Forum”, held at Assumption University (Bangkok, Thailand).

During the visit, a memorandum of cooperation was signed between Bishkek State University and Assumption University. The document provides for the development of partnerships in the field of academic mobility, the implementation of joint educational programs, scientific research, and the exchange of experience between teachers and students.

The delegation from Central Asia was represented by leading universities of Kyrgyzstan and Kazakhstan. On behalf of the BSU management, M.A. Muratalieva confirmed the university's interest in developing sustainable international cooperation and expressed gratitude to the management of Assumption University for organizing the forum and inviting participation. © Rakhat
